create_FloatTensor: create a FloatTensor on CUDA or CPU based on a boolean flag
create_tensor: create a torch tensor with a specified dtype on CUDA or CPU device
get_device: get the current CUDA device string or cpu based on a boolean flag
use_CudaTransferMinimizer: use CudaTransferMinimizer to keep models on GPU and minimize CPU to GPU transfers
use_GPUMemoryMinimizer: use GPUMemoryMinimizer to move models to GPU only during training to save GPU memory
